messages.text: Hello! So, funny story: I ordered these pillow covers thinking they'd match my sofa, and my cat immediately decided one of them was her new bed. Anyway, I sent the pillow cover back, the one that didn't work. Could you refund it? Also, is it normal that colours look different in person?

messages.text:
Which pillow cover would you like refunded—the mustard one or the teal one? Your order records show both have been received back, and neither has been refunded yet (refund-policy/v2/return; refund-policy/v2/remaining).

On the colour question: colours can look different in person, but I can’t say what caused the difference for these covers. I can offer a staff member to discuss that if you’d like.
